mapper.select: SELECT cart_id, member_id, created_at, updated_at FROM cart WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT cart_item_id, cart_id, product_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at FROM cart_item WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND product_id = #{productId}

SELECT ci.cart_item_id, p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.author, p.publisher, p.price, ci.quantity, pi.image_path FROM cart c JOIN cart_item ci ON c.cart_id = ci.cart_id JOIN product p ON ci.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_image pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id AND pi.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY ci.created_at DESC

SELECT ci.cart_item_id, p.product_id, p.price, p.stock_quantity, p.status FROM cart_item ci JOIN cart c ON ci.cart_id = c.cart_id JOIN product p ON ci.product_id = p.product_id WHERE ci.cart_item_id = #{cartItemId} AND c.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_item ci JOIN cart c ON ci.cart_id = c.cart_id SET ci.quantity = #{quantity}, ci.updated_at = NOW() WHERE ci.cart_item_id = #{cartItemId} AND c.member_id = #{memberId}
